site.title: Whole Earth Index (Multilingual)
site.tagline: Access to tools, ideas, and practices — in your language.
home.intro: A community multilingual shell around the Whole Earth Index archive (1968–2002). We reverse-engineer the public site structure, translate the catalog UI and issue metadata, and link out to Internet Archive page images.
footer.disclaimer: Unofficial community project. Not affiliated with Stewart Brand, POINT Foundation, or wholeearth.info.
footer.inspire: Method inspired by reverse-engineering-for-agents (inspect → recover structure → rebuild).
